title: GetSentinelCommand
description: Schema for Service Manager registry retrieval command OM2. This command is sent by the Orchestrator to the Service Manager to request the full representation of a specific Sentinel and its associated Assets.

type.description: NGSI-LD entity type. It has to be getSentinelCommand.

originator.description: Property. Component that generated the command.

timestamp.description: Property. Date and time at which the command was generated.

sentinelId.description: Relationship. Sentinel entity requested by the Orchestrator.
